name: ok_hook_rewrite
description: A hook/rewrite record: a plugin's hook changed the message list handed to the provider, and the loop recorded which phase, which plugin, and how many messages changed. This is the event that lets a reader prove the loop did not rewrite anything private — a log with no hook/rewrite has had no rewrite. Additive: no envelope change, no version bump (AGENTS.md rule 2).
